name: TopBar
summary: Horizontal app chrome — brand mark + breadcrumb + global search trigger + user menu. h-14 (56px); hairline bottom border. Pair with Sidebar (left) for the two-axis dashboard chrome.

rules: Visible focus ring required (outline + box-shadow per AGENTS.md hard rule 11).
Color is never the only signal — pair with label, shape, or icon.

dont: NEVER add backdrop-filter to TopBar — hard rule 16 (dense chrome).
NEVER skip the brand mark in left slot.
